description: This file defines functions and types for inspecting and managing Slack account credentials within the openclaw plugin SDK, including token validation, account configuration merging, and account inspection logic.

methods.name: inspectSlackToken
methods.description: Inspects a token value, normalizing it and determining its source and status.

methods.name: inspectSlackAccount
methods.description: Inspects Slack account configuration, merging settings, and determining token statuses and sources.
